name: MAT Firewall
author: matpluginsofficial

sections.description:
MAT Firewall is a comprehensive WordPress security plugin designed to safeguard your website from malicious traffic, brute force attacks, and unauthorized access. Whether you’re running a small blog, business site, or eCommerce platform, MAT Firewall provides robust security while maintaining performance.

Key Features:

  • Advanced Firewall Rules – Block or allow traffic based on IP, country, URI, HTTP methods, and more.
  • Rate Limiting & Anti-Brute Force – Set request limits to prevent spam, DDoS attacks, and abusive bot activity.
  • CDN Integration & Protection – Secure your site with CDN IP whitelisting and anti-spoofing measures.
  • Real-Time Monitoring – View blocked and allowed requests via a detailed security dashboard.
  • Lightweight & Optimized – Runs efficiently without slowing down your site.
  • Developer-Friendly – Supports hooks and filters for advanced customization.
  • Multi-Site Compatible – Manage security settings across multiple WordPress sites.

sections.installation:
1. Install via WordPress Admin:

    • Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
    • Search for MAT Firewall.
    • Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.

  2. Manual Installation:

    • Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org.
    • Upload it via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
    • Activate MAT Firewall from the Plugins menu.

  3. Configure Settings:

    • Navigate to MAT Firewall > Settings to set up firewall rules, rate-limiting, and security options.
sections.faq:
Is MAT Firewall free?

Yes, the free version includes essential firewall protection, rate limiting, and CDN security. For advanced features, consider MAT Firewall Pro.

What happens if an IP is blocked?

Blocked IPs cannot access restricted resources. You can configure how long they remain blocked in the settings.

Can I allow or block specific countries or IPs?

Yes! You can define custom rules to allow or block access based on IP addresses, countries, URIs, and more.

Will MAT Firewall slow down my site?

No. The plugin is optimized to ensure security without impacting performance.

How do I upgrade to MAT Firewall Pro?

Visit our website to purchase MAT Firewall Pro and unlock premium features.
